<issue>Issue Title: [FEATURE] Add support for Bedrock/Anthropic ToolChoice to Structured output
Description:
### Problem Statement
The `structured_output` implementation in the Bedrock and Anthropic model provider call the model with a hard coded `tool_choice: auto`: https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/main/src/strands/models/bedrock.py#L206
### Proposed Solution
To help get better results out of the model, we should be able to configure this ToolChoice to specify the newly added structure output tool: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_SpecificToolChoice.html
This can be done by creating a private class variable at initialization for toolChoice, and in this function we temporarily override it:
```
__init__(...):
self._tool_choice = {"auto": {}}
...
# https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/main/src/strands/models/bedrock.py#L191
"toolChoice": self._tool_choice,
...
temp_tool_choice = self._tool_choice
self._tool_choice = {"tool" : {"name" : tool_spec["name"]}}
response = self.converse(messages=prompt, tool_specs=[tool_spec])
self._tool_choice = temp_tool_choice
```
### Use Case
Get better result of the specified pydantic model being output by the LLM as a tool use
### Alternatives Solutions
N/A
### Additional Context
N/A
</issue>

277     def _format_bedrock_messages(self, messages: Messages) -> Messages:
278         """Format messages for Bedrock API compatibility.
279 
280         This function ensures messages conform to Bedrock's expected format by:
281         - Filtering out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
282         - Cleaning tool result content blocks by removing additional fields that may be
283           useful for retaining information in hooks but would cause Bedrock validation
284           exceptions when presented with unexpected fields
285         - Ensuring all message content blocks are properly formatted for the Bedrock API
286 
287         Args:
288             messages: List of messages to format
289 
290         Returns:
291             Messages formatted for Bedrock API compatibility
292 
293         Note:
294             Bedrock will throw validation exceptions when presented with additional
295             unexpected fields in tool result blocks.
296             https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ToolResultBlock.html
297         """
298         cleaned_messages = []
299 
300         filtered_unknown_members = False
301         dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = False
302 
303         for message in messages:
304             cleaned_content: list[ContentBlock] = []
305 
306             for content_block in message["content"]:
307                 # Filter out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks
308                 if "SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER" in content_block:
309                     filtered_unknown_members = True
310                     continue
311 
312                 # DeepSeek models have issues with reasoningContent
313                 # TODO: Replace with systematic model configuration registry (https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/issues/780)
314                 if "deepseek" in self.config["model_id"].lower() and "reasoningContent" in content_block:
315                     dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content = True
316                     continue
317 
318                 if "toolResult" in content_block:
319                     # Create a new content block with only the cleaned toolResult
320                     tool_result: ToolResult = content_block["toolResult"]
321 
322                     if self._should_include_tool_result_status():
323                         # Include status field
324                         cleaned_tool_result = ToolResult(
325                             content=tool_result["content"],
326                             toolUseId=tool_result["toolUseId"],
327                             status=tool_result["status"],
328                         )
329                     else:
330                         # Remove status field
331                         cleaned_tool_result = ToolResult(  # type: ignore[typeddict-item]
332                             toolUseId=tool_result["toolUseId"], content=tool_result["content"]
333                         )
334 
335                     cleaned_block: ContentBlock = {"toolResult": cleaned_tool_result}
336                     cleaned_content.append(cleaned_block)
337                 else:
338                     # Keep other content blocks as-is
339                     cleaned_content.append(content_block)
340 
341             # Create new message with cleaned content (skip if empty for DeepSeek)
342             if cleaned_content:
343                 cleaned_message: Message = Message(content=cleaned_content, role=message["role"])
344                 cleaned_messages.append(cleaned_message)
345 
346         if filtered_unknown_members:
347             logger.warning(
348                 "Filtered out SDK_UNKNOWN_MEMBER content blocks from messages, consider upgrading boto3 version"
349             )
350         if dropped_deepseek_reasoning_content:
351             logger.debug(
352                 "Filtered DeepSeek reasoningContent content blocks from messages - https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model#multi-round-conversation"
353             )
354 
355         return cleaned_messages

518                         modified_chunk = chunk.copy()
519                         modified_chunk["messageStop"] = message_stop.copy()
520                         modified_chunk["messageStop"]["stopReason"] = "tool_use"
521                         logger.warning("Override stop reason from end_turn to tool_use")
522                         callback(modified_chunk)
523                     else:
524                         callback(chunk)
525 
526             else:
527                 response = self.client.converse(**request)
528                 for event in self._convert_non_streaming_to_streaming(response):
529                     callback(event)
530 
531                 if (
532                     "trace" in response
533                     and "guardrail" in response["trace"]
534                     and self._has_blocked_guardrail(response["trace"]["guardrail"])
